description.value: Quay West is a waterfront restaurant perched on Campbell River's historic harbour with wall-to-wall picture windows and a large outdoor patio overlooking Discovery Passage and Quadra Island. The kitchen leans into Vancouver Island ingredients — fresh seasonal fish, local prawns, and regionally inspired West Coast dishes — and has earned multiple community awards including Best Seafood, Best Burger, and Best Restaurant with a View. Situated next to Robert V. Ostler Park and the downtown core, it's a natural stopping point for cyclists exploring the Campbell River waterfront.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for https://quaywest.ca/ is fully available and provides strong evidence for this Campbell River waterfront restaurant. Address (921 Island Hwy), phone (250-286-9988), and website URL are confirmed via the website; OSM had no address or phone to cross-check against. Takeout is confirmed by the 'Order Online' navigation item; a vegetarian patty option is explicitly listed on the menu. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only.
Careers page job postings are dated December 2021, which may indicate the page is not actively maintained, though the rest of the site appears current and the business shows no signs of closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service waterfront restaurant in Campbell River with confirmed takeout, vegetarian options, and a prime location on the harbour cycling route; a clear benefit to touring cyclists.
